tables.title: Off-Grid Area Lights | All-In-One (SL-AIO)
notes: Catalog table title is OFF-GRID AREA LIGHTS (left-hand table, SL-AIO-40L pictured).
Catalog prints the dimensions as 31.5 IN x 10.6 INx 8.4 IN and 39.2 IN x 14.6 INx 10.2 IN (no W/D/H order stated).
Listings icons: CE, FCC and RoHS Compliant (one merged cell for all six rows).
No bold (factory-default) CCT is marked in the FlexColor cells.
Color dots beside the part numbers: grey = Gray (-GY), dark red = Dark Bronze (-DB).

tables.title: Off-Grid Area Lights | SL-SAL
notes: Catalog table title is OFF-GRID AREA LIGHTS (right-hand table, SL-SAL-100 pictured).
Listings cell reads COMING SOON for both rows.
No bold (factory-default) CCT is marked in the FlexColor cell.

footnotes: Footer key (left): Turtle friendly icon, Gray dot, Dark Bronze dot.
Footer key (right): battery glyph = Exclusive long-lasting battery.
The feature strip also gives RP-SAL values (7 hrs battery charge time, 32°F to 149°F battery charge temp, -4°F to 122°F fixture operating temp); RP-SAL is not in this page's tables.
